primary_hostname.description: Primary domain name used for this mail server (e.g., in HELO, envelope sender, and TLS SNI).

items.description: A domain name (or list of domains) this server considers local (mail is accepted and delivered locally).

local_domains.description: List of domains for which this server will accept and deliver mail locally.

items.description: A domain name (or list of domains) this server will relay mail for (if the sender is authorized).

relay_domains.description: Domains for which this server will relay mail (e.g., for other internal hosts).

allow_hosts.description: Hosts allowed to submit mail without authentication (e.g., localhost and internal network).

allow_relay_hosts.description: Hosts allowed to relay mail for domains listed in relay_domains (without authentication).

tls_cert_path.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format, readable by Debian-exim).

tls_key_path.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format, readable by Debian-exim).

driver.description: Authentication driver: login, plain, cram_md5, dovecot, etc.

public_name.description: Optional public name advertised in AUTH (e.g., 'LOGIN').

server_condition.description: Condition to validate credentials (e.g., check password).

server_set_id.description: Macro to set authenticated user identity (e.g., $1 for captured group).

client_secret.description: Client password (for outbound auth, e.g., to upstream relay).

server_advertise_conditions.description: Conditions under which AUTH is advertised (e.g., ['!authenticated: *']).

auth_mechanisms.description: List of SASL authentication mechanisms to support. Only enabled mechanisms are included in config.

queue_run_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait before giving up on a deferred delivery attempt.

max_message_size.description: Maximum message size (in bytes) the server will accept (including headers and attachments).

split_config.description: Use split configuration files (recommended for Debian/Ubuntu exim4-config). If false, all config is in this single file.

use_spool_directory_as_spool.description: Whether to use the spool directory (set automatically by split_config mode).

name.description: Unique router name (e.g., dnslookup, local_user, manualroute).

transport.description: Name of transport to use if router matches (e.g., local_delivery).

domains.description: Domains to route (if driver supports domains).

local_parts.description: Local parts to route (if driver supports local_parts).

ignore_target_hosts.description: Hosts to ignore for this router (e.g., local IPs).

address_data.description: Arbitrary string to attach to address (e.g., user-specific options).

retry_use_local_domain.description: Use local domain in retry database lookup?

self.description: Special handling: 'pass' to skip self-delivery checks.

default.name: dnslookup
default.comment: Route mail via DNS MX lookup

routers.description: List of routers that determine how incoming mail is handled.

file_path.description: File or directory path for file-based transports (appendfile, maildir).

local_part_suffix.description: Suffix to strip from local part (e.g., '+*').

local_part_suffix_same_case.description: Preserve case of suffix when stripping?

to_file.description: Treat transport as writing to a file (appendfile/maildir).

unseen.description: Do not mark as delivered (for copy delivery).

default.name: remote_smtp
default.comment: Deliver via SMTP to remote hosts

transports.description: List of transports that define how mail is actually delivered (to files, SMTP, etc.).

statement.description: Raw ACL statements (multi-line, indented in config).

default.name: acl_inbound
default.comment: Basic inbound ACL — reject spam and viruses
default.statement:
deny
  message = This system is not configured to receive mail
  !condition = ${if eq {$domain} {localhost} {no}{yes}}

  # Reject messages from known bad IPs
  deny
    hosts = /etc/exim4/blacklist
    message = Your host is blacklisted

  # Reject oversized messages
  deny
    message = Message size exceeds maximum of 25 MB
    condition = ${if > {$message_size}{25M}{yes}{no}}

  accept

inbound_acls.description: Inbound ACLs (Access Control Lists) applied to SMTP connections and messages.

value.description: Value assigned to the macro (e.g., domain list, path).

macros.description: Global macros for common values (avoid hardcoding paths, domain lists, etc.).
